🔔 Morning Brief — What You Need to Know Before the Open

Markets & Futures

S&P +0.6%, NASDAQ +0.8%, DOW +0.5%
VIX down ~5% to roughly 20 — fear is easing but still elevated
Wednesday's ceasefire rally holding, but follow-through is cautious

Macro Backdrop

10-year yield at ~4.26%, 2-year at 3.78% (48 bps spread)
~25% probability of a rate cut by year-end now priced in
Fed March minutes: policymakers still open to hikes if inflation exceeds 2%
Oil near $100/barrel throws a wrench into the soft landing narrative

Energy & Geopolitics

Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed — only a handful of ships got through since the ceasefire, no oil tankers
Iran charging $1M+ per vessel for passage
WTI crude up ~1-2% pre-market to roughly $98.50
Philippines declared a national energy emergency on March 24 — oil reserves dropped from 57 to 45 days of supply as a country that imports 98% of its oil from the Middle East
The $4 billion MTerra Solar project north of Manila — already under construction since late 2024 — has begun exporting 85 MW to the grid. When fully completed, its 3,500 MWp of solar capacity will make it the world's largest integrated solar-plus-storage facility
South Korea sending a special envoy to Tehran for its 26 stranded vessels

Amazon / Jassy Letter

$200 billion in capex committed for 2026
AWS AI revenue hit a $15 billion annual run rate
Custom chip business (Graviton, Trainium, Nitro) generating $20B+/year at triple-digit growth
Trainium 2 largely sold out, Trainium 3 nearly fully subscribed, Trainium 4 being reserved 18 months early
Stock closed up 5.6% on the letter

Tubi / Streaming

First major streamer to launch a native app inside ChatGPT
100M+ monthly active users, crossed $1B in annual revenue, turned profitable in 2025
Free ad-supported model competing for younger viewers' attention with AI-powered discovery instead of premium content

Washington Political Drama

Democrats pushing War Powers Act vote when Congress reconvenes
70+ lawmakers have called for Trump's removal via impeachment or 25th Amendment
Notable crossover: former congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene, Tucker Carlson, and Alex Jones joined the calls

What to Watch This Weekend

US-Iran talks begin Saturday in Islamabad led by VP Vance — first direct negotiations since the war began
If WTI breaks and holds above $100, the inflation narrative changes completely
Defense stocks and energy names volatile in both directions

Wednesday's ceasefire euphoria was premature. Markets are recalibrating to a conflict that could drag on for months. The Islamabad talks are the next real inflection point.
